call.h: Two Germans and a Pole are held at {}'s airport with over 3,000 tarantulas stuffed in dirty socks
call.hint: a desert capital on the Pacific
call.clue: Jorge Chávez airport seizure, spiders bound for Germany = Lima, Peru

call.h: A whole 113-year-old wooden church is loaded onto trailers to be moved 5 kilometers away in {}
call.hint: a city north of the Arctic Circle
call.clue: A wooden church moved away from an iron-ore mine = Kiruna, Sweden

call.h: Pensioner in {} wins a cook-off in a medieval monk's habit with a 1290 tomato sauce recipe
call.tell: Tomatoes came to Europe from the Americas after 1500, so no 1290 recipe could use them.

call.h: Email outage blocks a pool chlorine warning at a theme-park hotel's sauna in {}
call.hint: where painter Max Ernst was born
call.clue: theme-park hotel sauna and a chlorine warning; Rhineland

call.h: Federal judge orders state to let Satanic Temple hold one-day holiday event in the Capitol rotunda in {}
call.clue: a state Capitol rotunda, a federal judge, a US state capital

call.h: Mayor in a spacesuit unveils a 60-metre rooftop sign in {} for astronauts on the Moon to read
call.tell: From the Moon, about 384,000 km away, a 60-metre sign is far too small to see, let alone read.

call.h: Woman declared dead wakes up in her coffin minutes before her cremation at a temple in {}
call.hint: a city on the Chao Phraya
call.clue: Buddhist temple cremation (Wat Rat Prakhong Tham) near Bangkok = Thailand
